reviews.comment: Dr. Sword is an amazing professor. Never fails to make his students laugh. Lab is very easy and engaging, one of the more chill labs I have ever taken. Class is very test heavy, so don't fail any of them and you should get an A in the class.

Dr. Sword is super funny and he has a passion for entomology and just wants to share it. No exams! and the assignments are also pretty easy. There is a debate project which sounds intimidating but it's not too bad. This was an easy elective class.

I feel so lucky to have had Professor Sword this semester! Amazing guy, super funny, and has such a passion for Entomology. The class itself is easy: no exams, no final, just weekly lecture quizzes, and a few fun projects throughout the semester. If you need an easy fun science credit, TAKE HIM!! Such a fun class and prof, he needs more hype!!

I took Dr. Sword for ENTO 402 - the BEST prof I have had at TAMU. Although the class seems like it will be boring, he finds a way to make it interesting with engaging lectures. Such a cool dude, he does poll questions in lectures that are on the exam, so go to class! Amazing prof who really cares and loves his students, he deserves more hype!
